title: Session 5: The stone and the rider
opening_question: In Daniel 2 a stone cut out without hands breaks the kingdoms and fills the earth; in Revelation 19 a rider on a white horse comes out of heaven. What does each one do, and whose kingdom stands for ever?

steps.question: What was the stone cut out without, what did it strike, and what did it become?
What kingdom shall the God of heaven set up, and how long shall it stand?
Who sat upon the white horse, and what is his name called?
What goes out of his mouth, with what shall he rule, and what name is written on him?

facts.text: Daniel's stone "brake in pieces" the iron of the image; the rider "shall rule them with a rod of iron".

steps.question: What do the great voices in heaven say about the kingdoms of this world?

facts.text: Daniel 2:44: the kingdom "shall stand for ever". Revelation 11:15: "he shall reign for ever and ever".

remember.text: The stone cut out without hands "became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth".
The kingdom of the God of heaven "shall stand for ever".
The rider on the white horse is "called Faithful and True"; "his name is called The Word of God".
"he shall reign for ever and ever"
